top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a mature, independently confirmed discovery with a defined scientific core: gut incretin physiology and GLP-1 secretion (Holst), proglucagon-derived peptide biology and gut and islet actions (Drucker), and identification and synthesis of the active truncated peptide (Mojsov). Large outcome trials have shown durable benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity, so the field has clearly changed. The three-person allocation is coherent for a discovery citation. The Mojsov/Habener priority question is documentary and cannot be settled from the material available to me at this stage, but it is not strong enough to justify withholding the award. No award is ranked second because the achievement is ripe.
